title: Embedding large subsets of Wasserstein spaces into Banach spaces
summary: Embedding subsets of Wasserstein spaces into linear spaces is a problem of both theoretical and computational interest. In this work, we prove that three classical and natural embeddings of Wasserstein spaces into Banach spaces of non-trivial type are bi-Hölder on subsets of Wasserstein spaces given by moment bounds. These embeddings, all considered in multiple applications, are the linearized optimal transport embedding, the sliced-Wasserstein embedding, and a particular kernel mean embedding.
